rules.rationale: The entry is an Android 13 prebuilt toolchain, SDK, JDK, NDK, Rust, host-tool or generated API snapshot. Android 16 must use the matching current prebuilt repository revision rather than copy version-bound binaries from A13.
rules.necessity: The capability is necessary to build Android, but the A13 binary revision is not a portable product customization.
rules.performance: Using the Android 16-matched prebuilt avoids unsupported host-tool and generated-code mismatches; no guest runtime payload is added.
rules.security: Avoids importing stale opaque executables and libraries outside the Android 16 toolchain provenance set.
validation_evidence: Audit limited these prebuilts to commit/file metadata and the Android 16 target-only build uses its own pinned prebuilt graph.

rules.rationale: The patch only removes GitHub workflow files. These files are repository-hosting automation, are not Android build inputs, and cannot affect the guest image or runtime behavior.
rules.necessity: No Android 16 port is necessary; each target repository follows its own current hosting and CI policy.
rules.security: Avoids copying stale third-party CI credentials, triggers or permissions into unrelated Android 16 repositories.
validation_evidence: Every file listed by the entry is under .github/ and no source, build, test, payload or product file is touched.
